exposure: BMI categories: non-obese (BMI < 30 kg/m2), non-Class III obesity (BMI 30-39.9 kg/m2), and Class III obesity (BMI >= 40 kg/m2)
cohort: This study included 3046 singleton gestations undergoing labor induction from 2013 to 2020 at a single center.
finding: Class III obesity was independently associated with a lower likelihood of achieving complete cervical dilation and vaginal delivery after labor induction, longer time to complete dilation, and increased need for multiple induction agents.
